name: dsh-memory
description: DSH 高级共享记忆插件：可自选储存区（复用 DSH storage 域）、跨会话/多智能体共享、评分/衰减/置信度记忆机制、LLM 自动抽取、设置页可视化面板

scripts.test: node scripts/pipeline-test.mjs && node scripts/hub-test.mjs && node scripts/external-test.mjs && node scripts/vector-test.mjs && node scripts/graph-test.mjs && node scripts/mcp-test.mjs
scripts.smoke: node -e "Promise.all([import('./lib/hub.js'), import('./lib/agent.js')]).then(ms => ms.forEach(m => console.log('ok:', m.name, 'inject:', m.inject.join(','))))"
